name: tr_steph
caption:
IF STEPH WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🐟 Feebas, the one nobody wanted: 6 teams passed, we took him at #7
🥷 Greninja, the assassin: the Baby-Faced Assassin before he was Chef Curry
🎯 Inteleon, the sniper: first player ever to 4,000 threes
✨ Arceus, the legend: 2 MVPs, including the first unanimous one
👑 Kingambit, the king: 4 rings, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2022
🔥 Cinderace, the ace: 38 years old, 31.3 points a night through 8 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Curry: 2009 draft, 7th overall pick (#7) by Golden State; Minnesota took two other point guards at 5 and 6 (6 teams passed on him); referred to as the Baby-Faced Assassin since a young age and Chef Curry in the NBA; March 13, 2025: first player in NBA history to reach 4,000 career three-pointers; 2x MVP (2015, 2016), first ever unanimous MVP; 4x NBA champion (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022); born March 14, 1988 (age 38)
